app/api/analytics/recently-viewed/route..name: Recently viewed
app/api/analytics/recently-viewed/route..description: Returns the products a customer has looked at recently so they can pick up where they left off.

app/api/analytics/track-view/route.ts.name: Record product view
app/api/analytics/track-view/route.ts.description: Notes which product a customer just looked at so it appears in their recently-viewed list.

app/api/bespoke/route.ts.name: Bespoke enquiry
app/api/bespoke/route.ts.description: Receives a custom ring request with the customer's details, budget and inspiration images, saves it and notifies staff.

app/api/cart/[id]/route.ts.name: Update cart item
app/api/cart/[id]/route.ts.description: Changes the quantity or options of a single item in the customer's shopping bag, or removes it.

app/api/cart/route.ts.name: Shopping cart
app/api/cart/route.ts.description: Lists everything in the customer's bag, adds a new item, or empties the bag entirely.

app/api/checkout/route.ts.name: Start checkout
app/api/checkout/route.ts.description: Takes the customer's cart and creates a Stripe payment so they can complete their purchase.

app/api/inventory/route.ts.name: Stock levels
app/api/inventory/route.ts.description: Checks how many units of a product are currently available.

app/api/orders/[id]/route.ts.name: Order details
app/api/orders/[id]/route.ts.description: Shows the full details of a single order for the signed-in customer.

app/api/orders/route.ts.name: Order history
app/api/orders/route.ts.description: Lists all orders the signed-in customer has placed.

app/api/products/route.ts.name: Product list
app/api/products/route.ts.description: Returns the catalogue of rings and jewellery with images, prices and options.

app/api/waitlist/route.ts.name: Waitlist sign-up
app/api/waitlist/route.ts.description: Adds a customer's email to the waitlist for a coming-soon collection.

app/api/wishlist/route.ts.name: Wishlist
app/api/wishlist/route.ts.description: Shows, adds to, or removes from the customer's list of saved favourites.

GET /api/analytics/recently-viewed.name: Recently viewed products
GET /api/analytics/recently-viewed.description: Returns the products the customer looked at recently.

POST /api/analytics/track-view.description: Records that the customer just viewed a specific product.

POST /api/bespoke.description: Saves a custom ring request with contact details, budget and inspiration, and emails the team.

PUT /api/cart/[id].name: Update cart item

GET /api/cart.name: View cart

POST /api/cart.description: Puts a configured ring or jewellery piece into the shopping bag.

DELETE /api/cart.name: Empty cart
DELETE /api/cart.description: Removes everything from the customer's shopping bag at once.

POST /api/checkout.name: Pay now
POST /api/checkout.description: Creates a Stripe payment for the shopping bag and redirects the customer to complete it.

GET /api/inventory.name: Check stock
GET /api/inventory.description: Returns how many units of a product variant are available.

GET /api/orders/[id].name: View order
GET /api/orders/[id].description: Returns the full details of one past order.

GET /api/orders.description: Lists all orders the signed-in customer has placed, newest first.

GET /api/products.name: Browse products
GET /api/products.description: Returns the full product catalogue with images, prices and available options.

POST /api/waitlist.name: Join waitlist
POST /api/waitlist.description: Adds a customer's email to be notified when a coming-soon collection launches.

GET /api/wishlist.name: View saved items
GET /api/wishlist.description: Returns the customer's list of favourite products.

POST /api/wishlist.name: Save to wishlist
POST /api/wishlist.description: Adds a product to the customer's list of favourites.

DELETE /api/wishlist.name: Remove from wishlist
DELETE /api/wishlist.description: Takes a product off the customer's list of favourites.
